entries.00d71405f10f5623: It sets as its mission "to continue to move people through its management and to be an entity needed by communities and society," and states as its management objective "to share a sense of happiness with all people involved with the company." In its long-term vision to 2030, "ICHIBANYA Long-Term Vision 2030," it describes its aim as a "food entertainment company," and its 8th Medium-Term Management Plan (the fiscal year ended February 2025 to the fiscal year ending February 2027) sets out the following: with domestic CoCo Ichibanya as the growth engine, to aim to increase sales per 1 store and the number of stores; overseas, to expand the store network through the FC system, centered on Asia and North America; and among domestic subsidiaries' businesses, to advance the development of new formats using M&A. In response to rising rice purchase prices and increases in personnel and logistics costs, the medium-term management plan has been revised. The plan's target figures concern future matters and are therefore not transcribed here.
